description: In one panel, comment timestamps use a numeric format with seconds ('11/9/2026, 11:36:42 AM') while History uses 'Nov 9, 2026, 11:36 AM'.
expected: One date/time format for all events in the panel.
suggested_fix: Use the History formatter for comment headers.

description: History sits at the very bottom, below the comments and composer, and leaves out plain comments. The reason a task was abandoned (a comment) is not in the trail, so an operator reconstructing what happened reads two sections in opposite scroll directions.
expected: An option to include comments in History, or a combined timeline view.
suggested_fix: Add an 'Include comments' toggle to History, or a short comment excerpt row.
